Reynaldi Wiratama Siregar is a Front-End Web Developer and Information Systems student at Gunadarma University. He specializes in Vue.js, React, modern JavaScript (ES6+), responsive layout design, and neo-brutalist / modern UI styling. He has founded RND Kreatif, a digital agency delivering bespoke web applications, and has worked on various high-performance web systems and community platforms.
